questions.question: What keyboard shortcut redoes an action that was undone?
questions.explanation: Ctrl+Y reapplies the last undone action in Windows applications.

questions.question: What keyboard shortcut opens a new tab in a web browser?
questions.explanation: Ctrl+T creates a fresh tab without closing existing ones.

questions.question: What keyboard shortcut reopens a recently closed browser tab?
questions.explanation: Ctrl+Shift+T restores the last closed tab and can be pressed repeatedly.

questions.question: What keyboard shortcut saves the current page as a bookmark?
questions.explanation: Ctrl+D adds the page to bookmarks or favorites in most browsers.

questions.question: What keyboard shortcut selects the browser address bar?
questions.explanation: Ctrl+L highlights the address bar text so a new URL can be typed.

questions.question: Which function key toggles full-screen mode in browsers and File Explorer?
questions.explanation: F11 switches between windowed and full-screen display.

questions.question: What keyboard shortcut minimizes all windows to show the desktop?
questions.explanation: Win+D toggles between showing the desktop and restoring open windows.

questions.question: What keyboard shortcut opens File Explorer in Windows?
questions.explanation: Win+E launches File Explorer directly to browse drives and folders.

questions.question: What keyboard shortcut opens Task Manager directly without the security screen?
questions.explanation: Ctrl+Shift+Esc opens Task Manager instantly, useful when a program freezes.

questions.question: What keyboard shortcut opens the snipping tool to capture part of the screen in Windows 10 and 11?
questions.explanation: Win+Shift+S activates Snipping Tool controls for capturing a screen region.

questions.question: What keyboard shortcut moves the cursor to the beginning of a document?
questions.explanation: Ctrl+Home jumps to the top of the document rather than the start of a line.

questions.question: What keyboard shortcut moves the cursor to the end of a document?
questions.explanation: Ctrl+End jumps to the very last character of a document.

questions.question: Which function key typically opens the help menu or help documentation?
questions.explanation: F1 has been the traditional help key since early Windows programs.

questions.question: What keyboard shortcut applies bold formatting to selected text?
questions.explanation: Ctrl+B toggles bold text in word processors and rich text editors.

questions.question: What keyboard shortcut moves to the next tab in a web browser?
questions.explanation: Ctrl+Tab cycles forward through open browser tabs.
